dsh.artifact_kind: pnpm deploy --prod of runtime/dsh (@sophia/dsh-runtime) from pnpm-lock.yaml
dsh.artifact_digest_scheme: sophia-tree-v2: SHA-256 over sorted (type, path, exec bit, SHA-256 or link target) lines for files and symlinks only (directories are implied; empty ones are install-script scratch); excludes node_modules/.bin shims and pnpm bookkeeping that records install time or the checkout location, including the deploy-local pnpm-lock.yaml (scripts/lib/tree-digest.mjs)
dsh.release_source: npm registry release published from tag dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2; shipped static files are checked byte-for-byte against the pinned source checkout by scripts/dsh-source.mjs --verify-release

source_build.reason: SMC-M02 qualifies the published npm release of tag dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2, installed from the frozen lock with registry integrity. No upstream source build is part of this unit; the S1-01 source-build egress block (xlsx from cdn.sheetjs.com) is therefore not on this path. The failed-step recovery fix 6a6f350 ships in these tarballs (ToolCallRecovery in dsh-agent-loop and dsh-session lib) and is exercised by tests/integration/tool-recovery.test.mjs.

model_route.release_baseline: D13: deepseek-official / deepseek-flash (unchanged; switching back is a bundle-patch change and a new recorded unit)
model_route.compat_note: SMC-M02 R1: pins the request shape of sophia-runtime-s1-03-dev. pi-ai 0.87.1 ships gpt-6-luna with supportsStrictMode true, which adds `strict: false` to every tool; the gate requires this compat value (checkModelRoute) and tests/integration/request-shape.test.mjs holds the whole shape

sophia_bundle.name: @sophia/dsh-bundle
sophia_bundle.source_commit_note: a commit cannot contain its own id; the release tag records it, and `pnpm artifacts` proves a checkout reproduces the recorded archive bytes
sophia_bundle.bridge_readiness: ready only after hello, binding reconciliation and the service's ready acknowledgement; not_ready without a service binding (S1-03)

launch_env: TMPDIR=<inside the install; dsh spill-local writes here>

presets.definition: identity only: each preset composes no plugin (plugins: []). The bridge mounts the role's preset on create and resume, applies the role's tool policy, and records the preset with a digest of its definition and that policy in the attempt's execution identity (SMC-M02 G3). The gate requires exactly this roster, unbroadened. The SMC-M03 research presets compose their research tools from S4.
